name: csharp.run_script
description: Run a C# script (.cs file) against the active Revit document. The script has uiapp, doc, and inputs in scope and returns a Dictionary<string, object> as the tool result. See tools/c#/README.md for the convention. Use this for one-off Revit API operations that don't fit the existing tools.

script_path.description: Absolute path to the .cs file to execute.

arguments.description: Key/value pairs passed to the script as the `inputs` global.
